info.name: Amazon Bedrock Converse API
info.description:
The Amazon Bedrock management API provides operations for managing foundation models, custom models, model customization jobs, provisioned throughput, and other Bedrock resources.

Contact Support:
 Name: AWS Support

item.name: Amazon Bedrock Converse with a model

variable.description: (Required) The identifier of the model to converse with.

request.description: Sends messages to the specified Amazon Bedrock model using the Converse API. This provides a consistent interface for multi-turn conversations across different foundation models, with support for system prompts, tool use, and structured message formatting.

item.name: Amazon Bedrock Converse with a model using streaming

variable.description: (Required) The identifier of the model to converse with.

request.description: Sends messages to the specified Amazon Bedrock model and streams the response back in real time. This provides the same consistent multi-turn conversation interface as the Converse API, with the added benefit of streaming for lower perceived latency.
